{{legend0|#808080|No votes}} | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Mazie Hirono]] | before_party = Democratic Party (US) | after_election = [[Mazie Hirono]] | after_party = Democratic Party (US) }}{{Elections in Hawaii sidebar}} The '''2024 United States Senate election in Hawaii''' was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the [[United States Senate]] to represent the state of [[Hawaii]]. [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] two-term incumbent [[Mazie Hirono]] defeated [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] former state representative [[Bob McDermott]]. [[Primary elections]] took place on August 10, 2024.{{Cite web|title=2024 State Primary Election Dates|url=https://www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/2024-state-primary-election-dates|access-date=August 6, 2023|website=[[National Conference of State Legislatures]]}} Hirono won the Democratic nomination with 90% of the vote, while McDermott won the Republican nomination with 51% of the vote in a six-way primary.
